acquisition method: followed by up to 20 data-dependent MS/MS scans with higher-energy collision dissociation
alkylation reagent: alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature in the dark for additional 30 min
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide at room temperature in the dark for additional 30 min
cleavage agent: Samples were then digested using the FASP method with trypsin
collision energy: normalized collision energy of 27%... fragmented by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) with normalized collision energy of 35%
fractionation method: separated at high pH with small columns packed in pipette tips (sRP)
resulting peptides were separated at high pH with small columns packed in pipette tips (sRP)
fragmentation method: fragmented by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD)
instrument: Orbitrap Fusion, Orbitrap Fusion Lumos, Q Exactive Plus, Q Exactive HF

Samples were analyzed on Orbitrap Fusion, Orbitrap Fusion Lumos, and Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometers (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Rockford, IL, USA) coupled with an Easy-nLC 1000 nanoflow LC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific), or a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Rockford, IL, USA) connected to an UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano System (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: Label-free protein quantifications were calculated using a label-free, intensity-based absolute quantification (iBAQ) approach
reduction reagent: reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol at 56 °C for 30 min
reduction concentration: reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol at 56 °C for 30 min
